headline: Historic District Commission reviews COA requests for 38 Pleasant Street, 33 Middle Street, 52 Main Street, and 17 Pleasant Street.
summary: The commission will consider Certificate of Appropriateness requests for a front door replacement at 38 Pleasant Street, gutters and downspouts at 33 Middle Street, HVAC replacement at 52 Main Street, and a sign permit at 17 Pleasant Street. It will also discuss a pre-application from St John's Episcopal Church for 48 and 48R Middle St. and review proposed HDC Rules and Regulations.
items: 38 Pleasant Street (Map 14, Lot 17) - Michael Craviero requesting a COA for replacement of front door
33 Middle Street (Map 7, Lot 85) - Beth Lazazzera and Michael Ibba requesting a COA for installation of gutters and downspouts
52 Main Street (Map 7, Lot 77) - Paula Realty II LLC seeking a Certificate of Appropriateness (COA) for HVAC replacement on roof
17 Pleasant Street (Map 8, Lot 73) - William Davis requesting COA for a Sign permit
48 and 48R Middle St. - St John's Episcopal Church pre-application for siding and window replacement of parish hall and repainting exterior of sanctuary
HDC proposed Rules and Regulations review
location: Rose Baker Center for Aging Well 2nd floor Conference Room, 6 Manuel F. Lewis Street, Gloucester, MA 01930
